query: What is Pinterest's most recently reported number of monthly active users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Pinterest’s most recently reported monthly active users were 661 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reported in its Q3 2026 results press release [1]. Pinterest’s most recently reported number of full-time employees was 5,265 as of December 31, 2025, reported in its 2025 annual report [2].
